input.summary: Vembanad Botanicals (V03). Quote and commercial proposal received. Corrected rosemary COA (batch VB-RM-2609-11, made 14 Sep 2026, retest 13 Sep 2028) clears the earlier retest issue, but rosmarinic acid is 10.4% by HPLC vs RFx spec 20% (RM-008). Equivalent quantity (Q|B3) and acceptance need a buyer decision. Still open knockouts: COA for the other nine lines (Q|B5), SDS with transport class (Q|H1). Other gaps: OTIF, rejection rate, need-by feasibility for 20 Dec 2026, kg conversion. Latest event: vendor asked who else is quoting and what target price would win KPC-2026-014. No new commercial data, no answer to our questions. Not answered: competitor info is not shared and target price is a buyer decision. Escalated to buyer. Earlier response requested by 14 Nov 2026.

input.detail: Vendor V03 asked who else is quoting on RFx KPC-2026-014 and what target price would win the award. The message gives no new commercial data and does not answer any open buyer question. I have not replied. Competitor information and target price guidance are not for the vendor and are not in the RFx context, so I cannot answer. Decision needed: confirm how to respond (I suggest a short reply that we cannot discuss other suppliers or award criteria and that we need the outstanding items). Outstanding items for the vendor: COA for the other nine lines (knockout Q|B5), SDS with transport class for each line (knockout Q|H1), OTIF and rejection rate, need-by feasibility for 20 Dec 2026, kg conversion, and a decision on RM-008 at 10.4% rosmarinic acid vs 20% spec (equivalent quantity Q|B3 needed). The vendor's response deadline is 14 Nov 2026. Once you confirm, I will draft the consolidated follow-up.
